name: LLM Popup
description:
Top-bar popup for querying LLMs: local Ollama, OpenAI-compatible APIs, Anthropic (Claude) and Google Gemini.

Features:
* Multiple provider profiles, each with its own URL and model
* Streaming responses
* Local conversation history
* API keys stored in the GNOME keyring (libsecret), never in plain text
* Configurable keyboard shortcut, including special keys such as the Copilot key

Network access: the extension only connects to the provider endpoints you configure.
Clipboard access: the "copy response" action copies the last response to the clipboard, and only when you trigger it.
